link.description: The start of the link, to recognize it by: the whole link is a password, so it's never sent back (FEED-2).

notify.description: Tell the account's phones when it adds, moves or cancels a match (FEED-8, NOTE-1).

active.description: false: paused, by the person or after the link stopped working (FEED-9); not read.

lastReadAt.description: When it was last read, whatever happened.

lastChangedAt.description: When a read last added or changed a match.

lastResult.description: What the latest read that worked found and did.

games.description: Games still to come in it.

problem.description: Why the latest read didn't work, or why it's paused.

stoppedAt.description: When it was paused because the link stopped working (FEED-9).

skipped.description: Events the latest read couldn't save, at most 20.

description: An assignor's calendar link, read into the account's matches every 30 minutes (FEED-1 to FEED-9).
